preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (has ownership privileges)

exploit_hint: Call the mint(address to, uint256 amount) function with the attacker's address as the 'to' parameter and a large amount value. Since this function is protected by onlyOwner modifier, the attacker must first ensure they have ownership of the contract. After calling mint, the attacker's token balance will increase by the specified amount, demonstrating the ability to inflate token supply and gain financial advantage.
